audit_metadata.title: One-Factor Forensic Audit Matrix: Fixed Reference (1398090) vs Corrected Adaptive Nominal 1% (1404454)

post_peak_status.diverging_dof: DOF 3 (Phase Field) at Node 61805 (x=0.940 mm, y=0.509 mm)

factors.job_1398090_value: 1.0 mm x 1.0 mm square plate, crack along y=0.50 mm
factors.job_1404454_value: 1.0 mm x 1.0 mm square plate, crack along y=0.50 mm
factors.evidence: Both bounding boxes are strictly [0, 1] x [0, 1] mm with crack along y=0.5 mm.

factors.job_1398090_value: Sharp slit with zero opening; duplicate nodes from x=0.0 to x=0.497059 mm at y=0.5 mm (45 pairs); tip at x=0.50 mm
factors.job_1404454_value: Sharp slit with zero opening; duplicate nodes from x=0.0 to x=0.497884 mm at y=0.5 mm (100 pairs); tip at x=0.50 mm
factors.evidence: Both models represent a sharp initial crack a_0 = 0.50 mm with coincident duplicate nodes across the crack flank. However, the duplicate node count differs (45 pairs in structured mesh vs 100 pairs in adaptive mesh) due to refined mesh discretization along the notch flank. While intended geometry is identical, unproven numerical equivalence under dynamic propagation remains until verified.

factors.factor: Constitutive Material Parameters (E, nu, Gc, l0, kappa)
factors.evidence: Exact float match in *UEL PROPERTY cards PROPS(1..5).

factors.job_1398090_value: u2=0 on N_BOTTOM (y=0); u1=0 on N_PIN (Node 1 at 0,0); u1=0 on N_TOP (y=1)
factors.job_1404454_value: u2=0 on N_BOTTOM (y=0); u1=0 on N_PIN (Node 37 at 0,0); u1=0 on N_TOP (y=1)
factors.evidence: N_PIN node coordinates in both models are exactly (0.0, 0.0); all bottom nodes clamped in u2; all top nodes clamped in u1.

factors.job_1398090_value: 212 *EQUATION constraints tying top nodes to N_RP (Node 999999) in DOF 2
factors.job_1404454_value: 210 *EQUATION constraints tying top nodes to N_RP (Node 999999) in DOF 2 with clean line-wrapping
factors.evidence: Every top edge node is rigidly coupled to RP with coeff 1.0, -1.0. Line wrapping verified.

factors.job_1398090_value: Step 1: dt=5.0e-4 (2000 incs to u=0.005 mm); Step 2: dt=2.0e-4, min_dt=1.0e-9 (5000 incs to u=0.010 mm)
factors.job_1404454_value: Step 1: dt=5.0e-4 (2000 incs to u=0.005 mm); Step 2: dt=2.0e-4, min_dt=1.0e-14 (target u=0.010 mm)
factors.evidence: Step increment size dt=2.0e-4 mm is identical; however, min_dt in 1404454 is 1.0e-14 compared to 1.0e-9 in 1398090. A smaller min_dt allows the Newton-Raphson solver to attempt cutbacks down to 10^-14 before declaring job failure, directly influencing at what residual displacement and load the solver terminates when experiencing severe post-peak divergence.

factors.job_1398090_value: Direct sparse solver, UNSYMM storage on UEL
factors.job_1404454_value: Direct sparse solver, UNSYMM storage on UEL
factors.evidence: Both execute UNSYMMETRIC DIRECT SPARSE SOLVER on 1 host MPI rank.

factors.job_1398090_value: Transactional committed/trial state management with LOP=0, 1, 2, capacity=100000
factors.job_1404454_value: Transactional committed/trial state management with LOP=0, 1, 2, capacity=100000
factors.evidence: Subroutine code in both files is identical line-by-line.

factors.job_1398090_value: 4-node quad with 2x2 Gauss integration; driving energy POS_M = 0.5*C12*(E_pos^2) + C33*(E11^2+E22^2+2*E12^2); degradation DEG=(1-d)^2+kappa
factors.job_1404454_value: 4-node quad with 2x2 Gauss integration; driving energy POS_M = 0.5*C12*(E_pos^2) + C33*(E11^2+E22^2+2*E12^2); degradation DEG=(1-d)^2+kappa
factors.evidence: Kinematics, B-matrix, AMATRX, RHS, and strain energy split equations are identical. SVARS indexing changes affect only output arrays.

factors.job_1404454_value: Present: 3-node CST with 1 Gauss point (wt=0.5, xi=1/3, eta=1/3); POS_M undegraded driving energy; 1,877 elements
factors.evidence: 1-point integrated CST triangles are softer and have lower order than 2x2 Gauss quads. 151 tri elements reside near crack path.

factors.factor: Companion Visualization Layer & UMAT State Transfer
factors.job_1398090_value: CPE4 with built-in *Elastic (1e-11); element output targeted DISP_QUAD (UEL); no SDV in ODB
factors.job_1404454_value: CPE4/CPE3 with *User Material DUMMY_MAT; blank UMAT stub; element output targeted DISP_QUAD/TRI (UEL); no SDV in ODB
factors.evidence: Neither job successfully wrote SDVs to ODB because both targeted UEL layers. Dummy UMAT in 1404454 has zero stress and zero stiffness, proven in Gate-6 isolation matrix (Dir 71 vs Dir 69: K0=138.0210 kN/mm identical to 6 sig figs).

factors.job_1398090_value: 15,192 elements; uniform structured quad mesh across entire ligament: h = 0.00301 mm (h/l0 = 0.40) from x=0.50 to x=1.00 mm
factors.job_1404454_value: 71,320 elements (69,443 Q4, 1,877 T3); highly non-uniform: h = 0.0015-0.0024 mm (h/l0 = 0.20-0.32) at notch tip, coarsening to h = 0.0085-0.0134 mm (h/l0 = 1.13-1.78, h > l0) at x >= 0.80 mm
factors.evidence: Spatial coincidence exists: the downstream ligament coarsens significantly relative to the tip (h/l0 rises from 0.235 at the tip to 0.67-0.88 downstream, peaking at 1.04 in [0.85, 0.90] mm), and severe Newton-Raphson divergence in phase-field DOF 3 occurs at Node 61805 (x=0.940 mm, y=0.509 mm, incident h/l0 ~ 0.64-0.70). However, because the adaptive mesh simultaneously introduces 1,877 linear triangles, differing notch topology, and unrefined downstream transition, spatial coincidence is NOT causal proof without an isolated one-factor test on uniform coarsening vs adaptive static mesh.
